en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic rural landscape with rolling hills, fields, and forest. A village with several clustered buildings lies on the left, while on a wooded hill to the right stands a prominent large building resembling a small castle or manor. A road lined with trees runs through the valley. At the bottom margin, there is a handwritten caption identifying the view.
